# Lantern 0.2.0 for Mac — Public preview
- Usage analytics now reports a persistent installation UUID, app-session UUID, local account username, platform and architecture. PostHog estimates country, continent and region from the connection IP and may resolve approximate city/coordinates; no GPS permission is requested. Mac also reports OS version, locale and time zone. This reporting is not anonymous. Turn off Share usage analytics in About & Updates to stop future usage events; saved opt-outs are preserved. - Shake your mouse or trackpad pointer back and forth several times to restore this Mac's screens to 100%, including software dimming. Enabled by default; turn it off in Settings > General > Shake mouse to restore brightness. - General settings remain usable in compact windows. - LAN control defaults on for new installations and older settings without a saved choice; saved opt-outs are preserved. Settings > Network includes Scan LAN. - Installation reports send automatically once without a popup, separately from usage analytics.
Existing settings, presets, pairing data, login preferences and required automatic updates are preserved. Use Lantern on a trusted local network and the same connection port on each computer.
This remains a public preview. macOS 13 and Intel are build targets; physical sleep/wake, hotplug, fullscreen/Spaces and another-Mac acceptance remain incomplete. Software dimming darkens screen content without switching off the physical backlight.

item.title: Lantern for Mac 0.1.5 — Public preview
item.description:
# Lantern for Mac 0.1.5 — Public preview
The first public Mac download is now available. This preview is signed by Khaos Studios LLC, notarized by Apple, and packaged as a universal DMG.
## Included
- Brightness controls for individual displays, your Mac and connected computers. - Saved presets, keyboard shortcuts and optional paired phone control. - Incoming LAN brightness control stays off until you opt in on a trusted network. - Updates check at launch and every 15 minutes while Lantern runs. Verified updates download, install and restart Lantern automatically, with no update opt-out setting. Active display tests restore their screens before an update restart. - Existing settings and computer identity are preserved. Older update opt-outs and skipped versions are cleared on startup.
## Install
Open `Lantern-0.1.5.dmg`, drag Lantern into Applications, then open it from Applications. Older development builds or clients with update checks disabled require this manual installation.
Built for macOS 13 or later, Apple Silicon and Intel. Native checks have run on the release Mac running macOS 27. Older macOS versions, Intel Macs, another Mac, sleep/wake, dock replug, fullscreen/Spaces, mirroring, clamshell and login/update restart behavior still need broader device validation. This is a public preview, not a claim that every monitor or dock has passed compatibility testing.
External hardware DDC control requires Apple Silicon and a compatible connection. Intel external displays and DisplayLink can use software dimming. Software dimming darkens the picture while Lantern runs; it does not switch off the physical backlight.
Restore local brightness with **Control + Option + Command + R** or the restore button. Experimental display power tests remain separate from ordinary brightness controls.
Report issues at https://github.com/snacbot/lantern-releases/issues with your macOS version, monitor and dock details. Do not include private computer names, pairing keys or credentials.
